short_description.text: Ish-bosheth — (illegitimate?) son of Saul (2SA 2:8). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Asahel — brother of Joab and Abishai (2SA 2:18), sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:24). Of the tribe of Judah.
Amnon — firstborn son of King David (2SA 3:2). Of the tribe of Judah.
Chileab — second-born son of King David (2SA 3:3). Of the tribe of Judah.
Absalom — third-born son of King David (2SA 3:3). Of the tribe of Judah.
Maacah — daughter of Talmai, King of Geshur (2SA 3:3).
Talmai — King of Geshur (2SA 3:3).
Adonijah — fourth-born son of King David (2SA 3:4). Of the tribe of Judah.
Haggith — wife (concubine?) of King David (2SA 3:4).
Shephatiah — fifth-born son of King David (2SA 3:4). Of the tribe of Judah.
Abital — wife (concubine?) of King David (2SA 3:4).
Ithream — sixth-born son of King David (2SA 3:5). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eglah — wife of King David (2SA 3:5).
Rizpah — concubine of Saul (2SA 3:7).
Aiah — father of Rizpah (2SA 3:7).
Baanah — commander of Ish-bosheth's military (2SA 4:2).
Rechab — commander of Ish-bosheth's military (2SA 4:2).
Rimmon — the Beerothite (2SA 4:2).
Mephibosheth — son of Jonathan (2SA 4:4). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Hiram — King of Tyre (2SA 5:11).
Shammua — son of David (2SA 5:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Shobab — son of David (2SA 5:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Nathan — son of David (2SA 5:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Solomon — son of David (2SA 5:14). Of the tribe of Judah.
Ibhar — son of David (2SA 5:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Elishua — son of David (2SA 5:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Nepheg — son of David (2SA 5:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Japhia — son of David (2SA 5:15). Of the tribe of Judah.
Elishama — son of David (2SA 5:16). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eliada — son of David (2SA 5:16). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eliphelet — son of David (2SA 5:16). Of the tribe of Judah.
Uzzah — son of Abinadab (2SA 6:3) who died for touching the ark (2SA 6:7).
Ahio — son of Abinadab who led the ark on a cart (2SA 6:3).
Obed-edom — the Gittite in whose house the ark of the covenant rested (2SA 6:10).
Nathan — the prophet (2SA 7:2).
Hadadezer — King of Zobah (2SA 8:3, 1CH 18:3).
Rehob — father of Hadadezer (2SA 8:3).
Toi — King of Hamath (2SA 8:9).
Joram — son of Toi (2SA 8:10).
Jehoshaphat — son of Ahilud and recorder in David's kingdom (2SA 8:16).
Ahilud — father of Jehoshaphat (2SA 6:16).
Zadok — son of Ahitub and priest during King David's reign (2SA 8:17), a mighty of valor (1CH 12:28). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ahitub — (grand) father of Zadok the priest (2SA 8:17, 1CH 9:11), son of Amariah (1CH 6:11). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ahimelech — son of Abiathar (2SA 8:17, 1CH 24:6). Of the tribe of Levi.
Seraiah — secretary to David (2SA 8:17).
Benaiah — over the Cherethites and the Pelethites (2SA 8:18), the fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:20). Of the tribe of Levi.
Jehoiada — father of Benaiah (2SA 8:18), a priest (1CH 27:5). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ziba — servant from the house of Saul (2SA 9:2).
Machir — the person who sheltered Jonathan's son Mephibosheth (2SA 9:4).
Ammiel — father of Machir (2SA 9:5).
Mica — son of Mephibosheth (2SA 9:12). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Hanun — King of the Ammonites (2SA 10:1). Of the tribe of Ammonite.
King of Maacah — brought 1,000 men to side with the Ammonites (2SA 10:6).
Shobach — commander of the army of Hadadezer (2SA 10:16).
Bathsheba — daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah (2SA 11:3).
Eliam — Bathsheba's father (2SA 11:3).
Uriah — the Hittite (2SA 11:3), thirty-seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:39).
Abimelech — son of Jerubbesheth (2SA 11:21).
Jerubbesheth — father of Abimelech (2SA 11:21).
Tamar — Absalom's sister, daughter of David (2SA 13:1). Of the tribe of Judah.
Jonadab — son of Shimeah (2SA 13:3 or "Shammah" in 1SA 16:9).
Ammihud — father of the King of Geshur, Talmai (2SA 13:37).
Tamar — daughter of Absalom (2SA 14:27). Of the tribe of Judah.
Ahithophel — David's counselor, the Gilonite (2SA 15:12, 1CH 27:32).
Ittai — the Gittite (2SA 15:19), seventeenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:29).
Ahimaaz — son of Zadok the priest (2SA 15:27). Of the tribe of Levi.
Jonathan — son of Abiathar the priest (2SA 15:27). Of the tribe of Levi.
Hushai — the Archite (2SA 15:32), David's friend (1CH 27:33).
Shimei — of the house of Saul (2SA 16:5) who threw stones at King David. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Gera — father of Shimei (2SA 16:5), son of Bela (1CH 8:5). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Amasa — set over David's army in place of Joab (2SA 17:25).
Ithra — father of Amasa (2SA 17:25).
Abigail — daughter of Nahash, sister of Zeruiah (2SA 17:25), (half-?) sister of King David (1CH 2:16).
Nahash — mother of Abigail (2SA 17:25) [and wife of Jesse, David's father (1 Chr 2:13-16) ?].
Shobi — the son of Nahash from Rabbah (2SA 17:27).
Barzillai — the Gileadite from Rogelim (2SA 17:27).
Chimham — the servant of Barzillai (2SA 19:37).
Sheba — a worthless fellow, son of Bichri (2SA 20:1).
Bichri — father of Sheba (2SA 20:6).
Adoram — over the forced labor (2SA 20:24).
Sheva — scribe for King David (2SA 20:25.
Ira — the Jairite, priest to David (2SA 20:26). Of the tribe of Levi.
Armoni — son of Saul (2SA 21:8). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Mephibosheth — son of Saul (2SA 21:8). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Barzillai — the Meholathite, father of Adriel (2SA 21:8).
Ishbi-benob — descendants of Raphah ["the giant"?] (2SA 21:16).
Sibbecai — the Hushathite (2SA 21:18) of the Zerahites. Of the tribe of Judah.
Saph — among the descendants of Raphah ["the giant"?] (2SA 21:18).
Elhanan — son of Jaare-oregim (2SA 21:19), seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:24).
Jaare-oregim — the Bethlehemite (2SA 21:19).
Jonathan — son of Shimei, David's brother (2SA 21:21). Of the tribe of Judah.
Josheb-basshebeth — first of "the thirty" of David's men, a Tahchemonite (2SA 23:8)/Hachmonite (1CH 11:11). Of the tribe of Judah.
Eleazar — second of "the thirty" of David's men, son of Dodo (2SA 23:9).
Dodo — an Ahohite (1CH 11:12) father of Eleazar, one of David's mighty men (2SA 23:9).
Shammah — third of "the thirty" of David's men, son of Agee (2SA 23:11).
Agee — a Hararite (Harorite in 1CH 11:27), father of Shammah (2SA 23:11).
Ariel — of Moab (2SA 23:20).
Shammah — the Harodite, eighth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:25).
Elika — the Harodite, ninth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:25).
Helez — the Paltite (Pelonite in 1CH 11:27), tenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:26).
Ira — son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, eleventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:26).
Ikkesh — father of Ira, one of David's mighty men (2SA 23:26).
Abiezer — the Anathothite (2SA 23:27), twelfth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Zalmon — the Ahohite (2SA 23:28), fourteenth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Maharai — the Netophathite (2SA 23:28), fifteenth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Heleb — son of Baanah (2SA 23:29), sixteenth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Baanah — father of Heleb, one of David's mighty men (2SA 23:29).
Ribai — of Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin (2SA 23:29). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Benaiah — the Pirathonite, eighteenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:30). Of the tribe of Ephraim.
Hiddai — of the brooks of Gaash, nineteenth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:30).
Abi-albon — the Arbathite, twentieth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:31).
Azmaveth — the Barhumite (Baharumite 1CH 11:33), twenty-first of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:31).
Eliahba — the Shaalbonite, twenty-second of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:32).
Jashen — son of Eliahba, twenty-third of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:32).
Jonathan — son of Eliahba, twenty-fourth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:32).
Shammah — the Hararite (2SA 23:33), twenty-fifth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Ahiam — son of Sharar (2SA 23:33), twenty-sixth of "the thirty" of David's men.
Sharar — father of Ahiam (2SA 23:33).
Eliphelet — son of Ahasbai, twenty-seventh of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:34).
Ahasbai — father of Eliphelet, son of the Maacathite (2SA 23:34).
Eliam — son of Ahithophel, twenty-eighth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:34).
Hezro — the Carmelite, twenty-ninth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:35).
Paarai — the Arbite, thirtieth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:35).
Igal — son of Nathan, thirty-first of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:36).
Nathan — of Zobah (2SA 23:36).
Bani — the Gadite, thirty-second of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:36).
Zelek — the Ammonite, thirty-third of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:37). Of the tribe of Ammonite.
Naharai — the Beerothite, thirty-fourth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:37).
Ira — the Ithrite, thirty-fifth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:38).
Gareb — the Ithrite, thirty-sixth of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:38).
Araunah — the Jebusite (2SA 24:16).
